_comment: Licence policy for everything that ships (project rule 'Dependency licences: free and permissive only'). build-notices.ts fails when a component's licence is not in 'allowed' and the component is not listed in 'approved'. 'askFirst' licences are reported as 'only after asking the user'; everything else (GPL, AGPL, SSPL, RSAL, BUSL, non-commercial, unknown) as 'not allowed'. Add an entry to 'approved' only after the user decided it, with the reason and the date.
